jobs.how: Each indoor unit group has its own block of objects (instance MMGGPP); refs here are M-NET 01, group 01. Start and stop with On Off Setup and confirm with On Off State. System Forced Off works per group or for all groups.

points.use: Write Active = Execute forced off for this group
Write Active = Execute forced off for all groups
Write Active = Prohibit local on/off at the remote

jobs.how: Write the operating mode and fan speed, then read the state objects to confirm. Dry mode and the Mid 1/Mid 2 fan speeds must first be enabled in the BAC-HD150 Setting Tool.

points.use: Write Active = Prohibit local mode change

jobs.how: Single-setpoint groups use Set Temp; dual-setpoint groups use Set Temp Cool and Heat and reject the other. The dual and setback objects only work with Old Model Compatibility Mode disabled.

points.use: Read: room temp (water temp on BU/AU groups)
Write Active = Prohibit local setpoint change

jobs.how: Map Alarm Signal per group and read Error Code for the category. If the M-NET line to the BAC-HD150 is lost, every group's Error Code reads Communication error.

points.use: Read: error category, 1 = Normal, 8 = Communication error
Read: expansion controller communication, Active = Error

jobs.how: Read the filter sign and reset it from the BMS. Local filter sign reset can be locked out at the remote.

points.use: Write Inactive = Reset to clear the filter sign
Write Active = Prohibit local filter sign reset

jobs.job: Lossnay and Air To Water groups
jobs.how: Lossnay groups use the ventilation mode objects and PWFY Air To Water groups use their own mode objects. They only respond on groups of that type.

points.use: Read: current Air To Water mode

checklist: With the BAC-HD150 Setting Tool, set the LAN1 (BACnet, factory 192.168.1.254) and LAN2 (factory 192.168.200.212) addresses before connecting LAN1; BACnet uses UDP 47808.
Set the device instance and groups in the Setting Tool, and enable Dry, Mid fan speeds, Setback or Old Model Compatibility Mode as the job needs.
Build each group's object instances as MMGGPP (M-NET number, group number, point number); the refs in this guide are M-NET 01, group 01.
Set BMS polling to at least 200 ms per property, and wait N x 200 ms after a ReadPropertyMultiple of N properties.
Verify reads of BI 10120 (M-NET Communication State), MI 10104 (Error Code), BI 10102 (On Off State) and AI 10109 (Room Temp).
Write BO 10101 (On Off Setup) = Run and confirm BI 10102 changes, then write a setpoint (AV 10110, or AV 10124/AV 10125 on dual-setpoint groups) and check for errors.
Write BV 10121 (System Forced Off) = Execute, confirm the group stops, then write Reset.
Map BI 10103 (Alarm Signal) and MI 10104 (Error Code) for every group, plus BI 19981 if an expansion controller is used.
